// Generator for main.tree, the old CLI's full command tree. It walks the OLD build's cobra root:
// copy this file into cmd/cerberus of a checkout of main (the live build's source) as
// clitree_gen_test.go and run, under a scratch HOME,
//
//	CERBERUS_CLI_TREE_OUT=<this testdata/clitree dir>/main.tree go test -run TestGenerateCLITree ./cmd/cerberus
//
// Each line is a command path, a tab, and the flags defined on that command (its local flags
// and the persistent flags it declares; inherited ones are listed where they are declared),
// sorted, as --name or --name/-x with its shorthand. Cobra's own help and version flags and
// the help and completion commands it adds at run time are left out. Do not commit it to main.
package main

import (
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
	"github.com/spf13/pflag"
)

func TestGenerateCLITree(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("CERBERUS_CLI_TREE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("CERBERUS_CLI_TREE_OUT unset")
	}
	var lines []string
	var walk func(c *cobra.Command)
	walk = func(c *cobra.Command) {
		var flags []string
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		add := func(f *pflag.Flag) {
			if f.Name == "help" || f.Name == "version" || seen[f.Name] {
				return
			}
			seen[f.Name] = true
			s := "--" + f.Name
			if f.Shorthand != "" {
				s += "/-" + f.Shorthand
			}
			flags = append(flags, s)
		}
		c.LocalNonPersistentFlags().VisitAll(add)
		c.PersistentFlags().VisitAll(add)
		sort.Strings(flags)
		lines = append(lines, c.CommandPath()+"\t"+strings.Join(flags, " "))
		for _, sub := range c.Commands() {
			if sub.Name() == "help" || sub.Name() == "completion" {
				continue
			}
			walk(sub)
		}
	}
	walk(rootCmd)
	sort.Strings(lines)
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, []byte(strings.Join(lines, "\n")+"\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
